rationale: This is a mechanical crossing of two already-tested archive variants (BothAnchorsCheapWithQuality and NoRedFlagQualityOwnHistoryCheap) with no new economic content, and it will be near-collinear with both incumbents while further compressing the effective cross-section through double MIN-truncation.

The escape-route logic is coherent, but the added net-operating-asset leg is largely nested in the working-capital leg it is supposed to police (act ⊂ at, same operating-liability term), so the third hurdle mostly re-vetoes the same firms and the proposal reads as an incremental leg-count variant on an existing conjunction.

Substituting the weak depreciation-adequacy leg with a post-depreciation cash-margin trend is a genuine channel change rather than a reweighting, the sign logic is internally consistent, and the only real risk is the oancf-driven coverage drop to roughly 7% that should be reported as a diagnostic.

The diagnosis that a six-valued integer consistency count cannot support a cross-sectional level slope is plausible and the SUMRANK repair is targeted, though the two legs both measure working-capital release and are correlated enough that the gain may be modest.

Deviation-from-own-mean is a defensible normalization not yet tested in this form and the sign direction matches the expression, but it is conceptually close to the archive's TS_MAX "accrual unwind" and TS_RANK own-history variants, and the claim that it "keeps magnitude information" is partly undone by the outer cross-sectional RANK.

This is essentially a re-run of ConjunctiveQualityOwnHistoryCheap, whose txp-in-MIN structure already returned 0% coverage — wrapping ZSCORE around RANK does nothing to stop NaN propagation — and the cited fmb of 3.87 belongs to a four-way composite, not to the tax leg itself.
